title: A Capacitary Approach to Semilinear Elliptic Inequalities with Potentials on Weighted Graphs
summary: We develop a capacitary approach to semilinear elliptic inequalities on weighted graphs with a potential. More precisely, we study the nonexistence of nontrivial nonnegative solutions of \[ Δu+w(x)u+v(x)u^σ\le0 \qquad\text{in }V, \] where \((V,ω,μ)\) is a connected, locally finite weighted graph, \(Δ\) is the associated graph Laplacian, \(σ>1\), \(v>0\), and \(w\) is a real-valued potential.
